dream_light_growth: The same hot late-afternoon sun Alice sleeps under, now on a bare, still clearing: flat glare, heat haze and dust, the kind of light that makes a footman sit and stare at the sky (environment fixed.dream_growth).

schemes.key_bearing: sun from the west, elevation about 33 deg falling to 29 deg (S01-S04); the little house throws its shadow east
schemes.fill: hazy-blue sky plus warm bounce off dry trodden grass and dusty ground
schemes.practicals_note: No lamps outside (architecture negative: no gas lamps). Grey-brown pepper-smoke drifting out of the open door in S03 catches the sun as a soft haze; it is atmosphere, not a light source.
schemes.quality: hot, flat-bright direct sun with short hard shadows and a faint heat shimmer; the wood edge behind sits in deep green shade
schemes.prompt_fragment_en: hot still late-afternoon sunlight from the west, hard neutral daylight falling at a steep side angle on a bare sunlit clearing, warm dusty bounce from dry grass, hazy blue sky, short crisp shadows, faint heat shimmer, the wood edge behind in deep green shade
